data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions 1,824 - 1,824
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross strengthening of prior year claims reserves of $1,824k (USD) in 2024, representing a c.41.1% increase versus the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024. This movement is reported in the Technical Provisions reconciliation as a "Change in estimates of prior year provisions" and reflects adverse development / IBNR recalibration across prior underwriting years (2021-2023). No specific catastrophe or named event is cited as the primary cause in the report and no LOB-level prior-year movement amounts are disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.
Reserve adequacy is monitored through quarterly review by the Asta Actuarial team and the Management Committee.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table row 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross, USD thousands). No explicit narrative explanation or per-line breakdown of the prior-year strengthening is provided. All monetary conversions: source amounts were reported in $'000; values above are presented in millions (native currency USD). A gross claims development triangle is present and was extracted (see _claims_triangle); no RITC line was identified. LOB-level PYD amounts are not disclosed in the report, so per-LOB impacts are not quantified.
